challenges.title: Create a Simple React Component
description: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces using reusable components. A React component is a function (or class) that returns JSX — a syntax extension that looks like HTML but compiles to JavaScript.
// Functional component (modern React) function Welcome(props) { return <h1>Hello, {props.name}!</h1>; } // Render it ReactDOM.render( <Welcome name="Alice" />, document.getElementById('root') );
React components receive props (properties) as input and return UI as output. Props are read-only — a component never modifies its own props.

The JSX editor for React challenges is not available in this offline build. To practice React, use CodePen with the React and ReactDOM scripts, or set up a local project with npx create-react-app my-app or npx create-next-app.
Study the React documentation sections: Components and Props, State and Lifecycle, Handling Events, and Hooks (useState, useEffect). Return to the map when ready to continue.
